description: This PHP script manages updating or deleting related module records in the vtiger CRM system, handling HTTP request parameters and invoking CRMEntity methods for data operations.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Provides methods for CRM entity data manipulation, such as retrieving instances and managing related records.

methods.name: delete_related_module
methods.description: Deletes relations between CRM modules based on provided IDs.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves new relations between CRM modules based on provided IDs.
